annotations.title: License Plate Format And Region Codes

description: How a country's license plate looks and reads (standard, size, format), its plate types (standard, diplomatic, police, taxi…) with example numbers, and every region code on its plates, grouped by region — e.g. which region is 77 or 199 on Russian plates. Use it for what a plate region code means (77, 777, AA…) and a country's plate format.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. RU.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.
